firstDraft.name: Bakelite Video
firstDraft.concept: A text-mode program running inside a 1930s wireless set. The structure is Reverse Video's: square windows with their names knocked into the frame line, double-framed dialogs for what you act in, unboxed rows walked by a highlight bar, reverse video for "this one", and rounded green glass kept for the machine alone. It is cut from Magic Eye's materials: dark oxblood Bakelite plates, porcelain type, old-rose printed labels, sage for everyday lit things and links, green-black glass for Vera and the fields, and #6dff9c as the one magic-eye light. It should feel warm, quiet and exact: an old radio at night with one green eye open.

designs.name: Signal Legend
designs.tagline: Signal Galley's green-black slate trays with every head set into its rail, reverse video for this one, square family surfaces against round machine glass, a thin case, and #6dff9c lit only for now and live.
designs.concept:
This is a refinement of Signal Galley. It keeps the slate trays, the one strip, the fortnight line with its breathing now lamp, the timetable margins and the masthead. On top of those it adds the grammar of an old text-mode program:
- Every tray's name, and its link, is knocked into its Oxford rail like a legend on a panel.
- 'This one' is always a quiet steel reverse-video block.
- What the family keeps is square; only the machine (the greeting glass, Vera's lines, the tubes and the cases) is rounded.

It should feel like a calm, well-labelled signal box at night. Grounded steel and slate carry the page, and the phosphor lights only what is live.
designs.companions:
- **Steel-cyan #a7c4d8 (h238, C .042).** It is the accent and a new --link token: every link set into a rail (All plans, All 4, Add an idea / All 12, All, Change a key, Earlier / Later), the Home and Chat links, the family bubble's 3px bar, the Chat thread's lead, the family's timestamp stops, the 2px phone cap, the hover afterglow on strips with no kind, the Settings strip designators (8%), and the 'Send where I am' icon.
- **Steel reverse video --rev #748a9b with --rev-ink #0b0e0c (5.4:1).** This is 'here': the bar item, Status and the settings gear, the tabs (All ideas | Restaurants, List | Month), the current Settings nav row, the menu's current row, the picker option under the pointer, today on the Plans month, and today's date leaf on the plans line. Amber now means only 'needs a look'.
- **--here-cell #1f2a31.** The phone's current tab cell, with a heading-cream label.
- **Secondary #b4c3cf.** The ways to start and the quiet keys, with a 30% steel border.
- **Slate.** Trays #0f1519, strips #161c20, designators #1c2328, card-edge #2f363c, a thin #34393e case.
- **Leads.** Cream #ebe6da for headings; the section leads cyan (Coming up), lilac (Lately added), sage (Status); the Keys lead is steel and Connected to is cyan.
- **Cobalt wash #4f60e6 at 2.5.** Kept as the greeting's second light.

The brand #6dff9c appears only on the mark, Send and the primary buttons, 'mind', focus, the now lamp, the live Status lamps, the power LEDs and the monitors.
decisions: Started from Signal Galley's palette and all 12 of its templates (variants/r9-idea-1/templates), plus a copy of wishes.html. Token changes: accent, secondary #b4c3cf, card-edge #2f363c, bezel #34393e. Everything else is kept exactly, including wash 2.5, glow .95, screenGlow .8 and quietFilter.

Bent the accent from #a3c3da to #a7c4d8 (about 2 dE away, same hue family). The brief's #a3c3da missed the protan section floor against the Wishes pink (4.6). #a7c4d8 clears every floor (sections 12.8 / 5.5 / 5.3) and is 10.5:1 on the ground.

Heads set into the rail. One --ox / --legend-bg pair draws every tray: a lead stub, 2px + 1px Oxford rules, and the slate fill starting under the rail. Each head's icon and h2 (Plex Sans 600, 1.15rem, cream) and each tray's links (Plex Sans 500 .875rem steel-cyan, 1px underline at .2em, 55% underline colour) sit on a 7px patch of page ground that knocks the rail out. The 44px hit areas are taken out of the line box with negative block margins. The dotted leaders are gone. 'All plans' moved from the track's terminus into Coming up's head (DOM, visual and Tab order agree), and 'Change a key' moved into the Keys head.
Bent the stub from 1rem to .75rem, with .5rem gaps, so every head's icon lines up with the strips' left edge at 1.25rem. The lead colour shows on that stub and on the icon.

One rail anatomy on every page. Status monitors, the Plans month (September 2026 in the rail with Earlier / Later restyled as rail links), Plans Coming up and Recently (icons added), each kid's wishes on the Wishes page (made a tray in markup), Chat's kids' conversations, and the count legends ('12 ideas', '4 shown') all use it. The counts stay .72rem mono caps labels, not heads.

Reverse video: a solid #748a9b block with dark ink, 2px corners, no glow, used everywhere; the latched key is gone. Hover on the nav is a 16% steel tint. On the phone the tab bar is full-height cells, and the current one is #1f2a31 with a 2px steel cap.

Square family, round machine. --r / --r-lg / --r-sm are 2px, so every key, field and panel is square, and trays, strips, the ask box, starters, chips, tags, the mic key and the restaurant tile are 2px. The greeting (12px), Vera's bubbles (12/12/12/4), the tubes, the cases, her presence tiles and the people's round faces keep their curves.

The thin case, as briefed: .45rem bezel, 12/16px corners, flat #34393e, an inset #59616a edge, a 1px engraved groove under the tube, 8 fine vent slots and the #6dff9c LED. The flush scopes on Status and Ideas are 7px.

Status. Heads are in the rails (sage, steel and cyan leads). Lamp designators are 2.25rem, with an 8% sage fill only when on. Strips are compact and trays end with their rows. The spend tray is full width with its flush tube at 18rem, so Who answers, Keys, Connected to and the spend readout fit one 1280x900 screen.

Home.
- The day tiles are 10% cyan over #1c2328, with cream 1.6rem lining tabular numerals.
- The track ends on its last ring.
- Stamps are .03em in a 7.5rem margin, and `text-wrap:balance` is on the titles.
- Ticks and checkboxes are one 4px rounded-square well, with an amber edge when late and lit sage when done.
- The facts divider is dropped (1ch gap).
- The afterglow is in at .08s and out over .9s.
- The kids' wishes tint is held to 10%.

Type is one superfamily. IBM Plex Sans is used for reading and titles, Plex Mono for the machine, and VT323 only in the tubes; DM Sans and opsz 40 are dropped. The steps are masthead 2.9rem/700 at -.018em with a 44ch balanced deck on the baseline, heads 1.15rem/600 (the panel and summary heads too), strip titles 1rem/600 cream, detail .875rem, facts .78rem mono tabular, and caps labels .72rem at .06em.

Chat has one time gutter. Times are .74rem Plex Mono, steel and nowrap, absolutely placed in an 8.5rem left gutter. A 1px #465260 line drops from Vera's screen tile through the rail and down the gutter, with a sage stop beside each of her times and a steel one beside the family's, and it ends in a hollow sage ring beside the message box. The box is indented to the bubbles' column. Family bubbles are square #1d252b with a 3px steel bar, at most 58ch. Below 40rem the times fold into the bubble head and the line goes.

Bent the Ideas radar. It is a centred 8.5rem figure under the lines, with its caption running full width below it. A 7rem float still squeezed 'North at the top…' to four lines. The search is full width, with Kind, Status, For and Filter at 2.75rem, and the tabs are square keys.

Phone: Send sits on the From row (the select shrinks without wrapping, the mic and Send are at the end, and 'Send where I am' is on the next row). Heads tighten so 'Lately added + Add an idea All 12' stays on its rail. The fortnight line stays upright.
Plans: weekend columns at 60% #1c2328, transparent cells, and today in steel reverse video. Event targets are enlarged, so 0 of 29 are under 44px.

Settings overview: the cards became the house strip (a 3.5rem designator at 8% steel, amber for 'needs a look', Vera's screen as her designator), in a slate tray with no rail, because the masthead's rule is already its head. The nav row uses reverse video.

Kept every Signal Galley control and fix: the select:open and checkbox rings, the #1b2126 / #5b6570 wells, base-select pickers (now square, with reverse video on the option under the pointer), the next-more nowrap row, the desks, the greeting glass and cobalt corner, and `.setup.setup` amber as the very last rule. The CSS is 24,374 characters: the stations and chat selectors are shortened and the hover glow is folded into one rule.
designs.measures:
Full render: 0 hard checks failed and 0 guidelines missed.

- **Contrast:** ink_on_bg 12.49; brand_on_bg 15.18.
- **Green share / hue entropy:**

| Page | Green share | Hue entropy |
|---|---|---|
| Home | 40.4% | 0.565 |
| Ideas | 85.2% | 0.49 |
| Chat | 82.5% | 0.368 |
| Status | 90.8% | 0.344 |

- **CIEDE2000, typical / deutan / protan:** kinds 13.6 / 5.5 / 7.4; sections 12.8 / 5.5 / 5.3.
- **Greeting:** corner pixel (1150,120) = (26,34,50), the cobalt light; green pool (100,530) = (34,53,40).
- **Targets:** 0 under 44px on every page: Home 0/56, To do 0/97, Plans 0/29, Settings 0/32, Chat 0/29, Ideas 0/49, Status 0/28, phone Home 0/57.
- **Page health:** no sideways scroll anywhere; smallest text 11.52px.
- **CSS:** 24,374 characters.
strengths: One legend anatomy on every tray and every page: Home, Status, Plans (month and list), To do, Ideas, Wishes and Chat's kids' list. That is Reverse Video's best idea quieted to sentence-case Plex Sans, with links that look like links, and it removes the dotted leaders and the stacked double rules.
'Here' has a single drawing everywhere (bar, tabs, Settings nav, menu, picker option, today). It is a calm steel block rather than Reverse Video's pale slab. Amber now means only 'needs a look'.

Square family surfaces against round machine glass reads at a glance and holds on every page: keys, fields, trays, strips and bubbles are square, while the greeting, Vera's lines and the tubes are round.
The thin case, asked for since round 7, is finally built: flat #34393e, a fine edge, a groove, vents and a green LED, with flush scopes on Status and Ideas.
The Chat thread line drops from Vera's screen tile through a single left time gutter to a sage ring at the box. Speakers are told apart by side, mark and stop colour, and no time sits on both sides.
Status is its own page now: legends in the rails, sage lamp designators, and the whole health readout plus the spend tube on one 1280x900 screen.

Every floor and every target is met: 0 small targets on all 13 renders, the protan section floor is fixed by the accent nudge, and the greeting's cobalt corner and green pool are exactly Signal Galley's.
The type pairing is closed: Plex Sans with Plex Mono and VT323 only in the tubes, on clear steps. Mastheads sit on one baseline, and titles, stamps and facts align along tabular columns.
weaknesses: The steel companion (C .042) and the reverse block (#748a9b) fall under the metric's saturation threshold. The measured green share therefore rises above Signal Galley's: Chat 82.5% against 74.6%, Status 90.8% against 73.8%, Ideas 85.2% against 73.7%. To the eye the steel shows in links, reverse blocks and the phone cell, but a judge reading the numbers may call it more monochrome than the periwinkle was.

As a deliberate refinement it stays close to Signal Galley. Home above the fold, the greeting and the fortnight line change little; most of the new look is below the fold, in Chat, and in the controls.
The thin flat case reads more like a modern display than an IBM 5151. The soul lens may miss the old chunky bezel's warmth, and the groove is barely visible at 1x.
The rail now carries two voices: sentence-case sans heads, and mono caps count legends ('12 ideas', '4 shown (up to 100).'). The period on the To do count reads a little oddly in a legend.
The To do stamps still stack in two parts ('WAS DUE' over '2 DAYS AGO'); they only go on one line on the phone. At 7.5rem no single line fits, so 'on one line' is read as each part never wrapping.
In Chat's left time gutter, a family message's time sits far from its right-hand bubble. Only the steel stop and the row alignment tie them together.
Vera's screen as a full-height designator on the Settings overview is striking, but it is the one glowing block in an otherwise square grey grid.
A kid viewing her own Wishes gets a tray whose head is screen-reader-only, so its rail shows no legend. Plans' Coming up and Recently icons are grey, with no lead colour.
At 24,374 characters the CSS leaves little room for later additions.

designs.name: Programme Guide
designs.tagline: The listing set on slate: every part is a band with its head column inside, every list is a one-line row read across a dotted leader to a column of facts, a denim needle marks where you are, and #6dff9c lights only where the machine is live.
designs.concept: Magic Eye's programme-guide structure (head column, one-line timetable rows, the tuning scale and needle, the one-screen month, a seven-step type system in two widths), moved off the wine and the switched-off black margins onto Signal Galley's green-black slate. The head column now lives inside each slate band, so the margin is material rather than empty. The feel is a well-set TV listing or station timetable lit by one green tube: calm, grounded, readable in columns, and the bright phosphor is kept for the mark, Send, 'mind', focus, the live lamps and the monitors.
decisions: Structure from Magic Eye (variants/r8-rand-1 home.html and _ask.html as the base), rebuilt as my own templates in variants/r9-idea-2/templates: home, _ask, _ui (chat_line and waiting_line put speaker and time before the bubble, for the gutter), chat, status, ideas, restaurants, tasks, plans, plans_month and settings. Every word is kept (word check 3.7% on Home, the same date-driven baseline as every carried palette; 0% elsewhere).

BANDS, NOT BLACK MARGINS: .band is a full-width #10161a slate with a 1px #2d353b top rule, and 1.25rem of black between bands. At 64rem and up its grid is 10rem head column + content. The head column holds the section icon in its section colour, the 1.45rem display head, links in Plex Mono .74rem spaced caps in denim with 44px targets, and the section's own note (.8rem dim), e.g. the Google Calendar note, the setup note, the To do time-zone note and the Setup link on Settings. Below 64rem the head sits above the rows. Any main>.panel whose first child is an h2 becomes the same band through a float head, which carries the system onto pages I did not template (Status' lower sections, Family's Add somebody, and so on).

The masthead uses the same grid: the title icon hangs at the right of the head column and the h1 starts on the content line, so title, band contents and row designators share one vertical edge on every page.

ONE ROW (.row) is used on Home (Coming up, To do, Lately added, kids' wishes, Something to eat), Status lamps, the Ideas and Restaurants lists, the To do page, the Plans list, the Settings index, the kids' conversations and the Family list. Its slots are: designator; title (1rem/600, cream); a dotted #3a454c leader sitting on the baseline; detail in ink-2; facts in Plex Mono .78rem tabular, right-aligned. Odd rows are zebra, min height 2.75rem, and the whole row is the target (stretched link). Titles are underlined only on hover or focus. On hover the row goes to surface-3 with a 2px needle, in at once and out over .9s (it fades colour, not width). The motion frames step (40,50,59) → (31,39,46) → (24,31,36) → zebra.

Bent from the brief because the page asked: the facts column is 9.75rem, not 7rem, so 'was due 2 days ago' and 'due in 2 days, 19:56' stay on one line. It is the same width in every Home band, so details and facts line up down the whole page. Date designators are 4rem to hold a 1.5rem Plex Mono numeral beside VT323 month and weekday. Status lamps use a 2.75rem designator and no facts column (lessons: a lamp alone in a wide designator is dead space). A row with no detail drops its leader.

The needle is #84a0c4, not the brief's #98b4d8. The brief's value misses the section protan floor against the Wishes pink (1.8). #84a0c4 clears it (5.4) and stays 14.8/20.3 dE from Ideas and Plans, 7.2:1 on bg and 5.6:1 on surface-3. It also reads as real denim rather than periwinkle.

The greeting keeps Magic Eye's arrangement: Vera, her screen and the date (VT323) in the head column, the question and the box in the middle, and Next up at the right (22.5rem). It sits on the lit glass pool restored from the base (#0f1513 glass, green rising bottom left, cobalt corner). Samples: corner (1150,120) = (23,36,46); the green pool inside the greeting (60,380) = (24,46,33). The ask box is one filled, bounded field (#0a0f0d) with its resting 38% brand edge and the lit sage frame and halo while typing, plus the small green › prompt mark. The bar is tightened so From, the select, Send where I am, the mic and Send fit one line on desktop and Send stays beside the mic on the phone.

HERE IS THE NEEDLE: the bar carries a tuning scale (1px rule, minor ticks every 8px, majors every 40px in #47535b) with a 2px vertical needle under the current place (Home's is under the mark), and the label turns cream. The phone's current tab is a #1f272e solid with a 2px needle cap.

LAMP LEGEND: #6dff9c appears only on the mark, Send, 'mind', the prompt mark, focus rings, Status' live lamps, the monitors and their LEDs. Sage marks done, lit and checked. Amber marks late and the setup steps (hollow amber rings, not squares, so they no longer look like To do's ticks). Off is a hollow red lamp.

Each item's stop is on the track, a 1px tick joins the stop to its plate, and in a timetable the time hangs in the margin. Give Coming up (cyan calendar), To do (lemon), Lately added (lilac), The kids' wishes (pink; its gift icon is the only bare icon on Home now) and Finish setting up (amber) each a 1.75rem ring in the section colour: the `.title-icon` treatment at a smaller size, `border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ld) 70%,var(--bg));border-radius:50%`. Merge the two track implementations, `.stations`/`.across` (Coming up, the Plans list) and `.track` (To do, Status, the nav, setup), into one `.track` with an `.across` modifier. Declare the 12px hollow ring once instead of five times (the stations mark, `.said-them::before`, `.your-turn::after`, `.settings-nav li::after`, `.setup-list .number`). firstDraft.name: Signal Lines
firstDraft.concept: Signal Galley's materials (green-black slate trays, strips, Plex type, the chinned case, the lit greeting) are unchanged. Signal Box's line art now runs through every page as one grammar: a ring holds each page's icon and its bracket holds the head, a steel track carries anything with a time or an order, and hollow stops sit on the tracks. It should feel like a control-room mimic panel drawn with a fine pen. The lines show how each page is organised, and the phosphor lights only what is happening now.

plan.reading:
The colour question is settled. Eight rounds and about a hundred palettes keep landing in one lane: a cool, low-chroma slate or steel (C about 0.010-0.016, h about 229-245) carried in solids that have a job, over a green-black ground. Around it go cream or bone ink near 12.5:1, lit sage for done and on, amber only for "needs a look", and the exact #6dff9c only for the mark, Send, "mind", focus, live lamps and the tubes. Every warm, pink, wine, violet, teal and green-family companion has lost, Magic Eye's wine included. The one colour move still asked for comes from the owner's lens: swap the periwinkle for a period, CGA-leaning steel-cyan.

Structure decides now. Round 8's two leaders tied (Signal Galley 7.87, Reverse Video 7.86). Skeptic, system, feedback, soul and interaction each proposed the same child in their notes, which is also the breed lessons.md records: Signal Galley's green-black materials, fortnight line and timetables, with Reverse Video's legends in the line, a quiet reverse video for "this one", square family surfaces against round machine glass, Send on the From row and the full-width Ideas search. The consensus child has won three rounds running, so brief 1 builds it as the refinement of the leader.

Four problems are still open in every entrant:
- The thick, rounded pewter case: every lens wants it thinner, squarer and more detailed.
- Status: it is the least changed page in Signal Galley and the least green in Reverse Video.
- Chat's split time gutters.
- Fine line art that groups and segments, which the feedback lens rewards most: it survives only in Signal Galley's Coming up.

Two ideas the judges named are still unbuilt:
- Magic Eye's programme-guide structure (one-line timetable rows, hanging heads, a one-screen month, the shortest Home). It came first with style and got interaction's best sight line, and it lost only on colour and finish. Skeptic and type both asked for it on slate.
- A cockpit-grade colour code with a thin, square instrument case. No palette has tried that family.

The field's risk is slate sameness, so both new briefs take their difference from structure and stay inside the owner's colour lane.

briefs.name: Programme Guide
briefs.brief:
START FROM Magic Eye's structure:
- variants/r8-rand-1/templates (home.html, _ask.html);
- the non-colour parts of its css: the band layout, margin heads, one-line rows, the one-column To do timetable, the month rows, the tuning scale and the row afterglow.
Then throw away every wine, rose and oxblood value and the CSS bracket pseudo-elements, and apply the following.

TOKENS (all checked for contrast)
- Ground and fills:
  - bg #0b0e0c;
  - --band #10161a: every section's slate band;
  - --zebra #161d22: the alternate rows, blue-bar listing paper on slate;
  - surface #151b1e: raised act boxes (ask, filters, forms);
  - surface-2 #1a2125;
  - surface-3 #1f272e: row hover and the family's bubble;
  - field #0c1113.
- Lines: line #20272b, line-2 #2c3439, card-edge #2e343b, edge #66727a.
- Text:
  - ink #d4cfc4 (12.5:1), ink-2 #b6b1a7, dim #9f9b92, faint #928e85;
  - heading #ebe6da, label #a4b0c2;
  - accent, the NEEDLE: a denim steel #98b4d8 (h255, C .060; 9.1:1 on bg; 17.1/6.4/8.4 from plans and 15.7/8.8/11.8 from ideas). It is kept a step from brief 1's steel-cyan so the field does not converge on one accent.
  - secondary #b7c1d1.
- Colours: lit and outing #86d9a6; the learned section colours.
- Parts: bar #0f1417, bezel #363b40, bubble #111712, bubble-them #1f272e.
- Light: wash #4f60e6 at 2.4, restoring the greeting's second light that Magic Eye dropped; glow .9; screenGlow .8; quietFilter.

1) BANDS, NOT BLACK MARGINS
- Every section is a full-width --band with its head column INSIDE the band: 10rem wide at 64rem and up, and the head above the rows below that. The margin is then slate material, not switched-off black, which answers the hanging-margin charge against Magic Eye and Side-Head Bindery.
- The head column holds:
  - the section icon in its section colour;
  - the head;
  - its links under the head, in spaced caps (Plex Mono .72rem, 500, +.06em, needle colour, 44px targets);
  - the section's own note, moved there (e.g. 'Google Calendar is not connected, so these are the plans the bot made.', .8rem dim).
- A 1px #2d353b rule tops each band; 1.25rem of black separates bands.
- Short sections collapse to their content. The kids' wishes and Something to eat share one band, side by side.
- Home order: greeting; Finish setting up; Coming up; To do; Lately added; then the kids' wishes with Something to eat. Change the DOM so DOM, visual and Tab order agree.

2) ONE ROW, used everywhere: Coming up, To do, Lately added, the kids' wishes, the Status lamps, the Ideas list, the To do page, the Settings index, Family and Memory.
- The slots, in order:
  - a 3.25rem designator: a big lining tabular day numeral (1.5rem Plex Mono) with the month and weekday in VT323, or the kind icon on a 14% (cool kinds) or 6% (warm kinds) tint, or a lamp;
  - the title, 1rem/600 in the heading colour;
  - a 1px dotted #3a454c leader that fills the gap, so a 900px row stays one line of sight;
  - the when or detail in ink-2;
  - a facts column fixed at 7rem, right-aligned, Plex Mono .8rem tabular ('in 2 days'; 'was due yesterday' in amber).
- Zebra: odd rows are --zebra with 2px radius. Rows are at least 2.75rem, and the whole row is the target.
- Titles are underlined only on hover or focus.
- Hover: surface-3 with a 2px needle down the left edge, in at once and out over .9s.

3) THE GREETING
- Keep Magic Eye's arrangement: Vera and the date hung in the head column, the question and ask box in the middle, Next up at the right.
- Set it ON the lit glass pool: green rising from the bottom left and the cobalt corner, which soul calls load-bearing.
- The ask box is a filled, bounded field with the lit sage frame and halo when typing. Keep the small green '›' prompt mark. No underline-only field.
- Starters are flat, square keys with no brackets.

4) 'HERE' IS THE NEEDLE
- The tuning scale under the bar is fine line art: a 1px #2d353b rule, minor ticks every 8px, majors every 40px in #47535b, and a 2px needle under the current place, whose label turns heading colour.
- The same needle marks the current tab, the current Settings entry, the hovered row and picker option, and today on the month (an inset 2px needle and an outlined numeral, not amber).
- Phone: the current cell is a #1f272e solid with a 2px needle cap.

5) LAMP LEGEND
- #6dff9c only on the mark, Send, 'mind', the prompt mark, focus, the live lamps and the tubes.
- Sage for done and on; amber for late and needs a look; a red hollow lamp for off.

6) TO DO
- Magic Eye's one-column timetable: the tick, then '#id · title', then owner and due in tabular figures, then 'Edit, complete, or snooze'.
- The reminder line is indented and dim, and an opened editor spans the row.
- 0/97 small targets.

7) PLANS
- The month on one screen: 5rem cells, transparent with 1px rules, weekends shaded at a 60% mix of #1c2328.
- Events are color-mix(plans 12%, #1c2328) plates with a 2px plans edge.
- The list is bands of rows.

8) STATUS
- Three bands (Who answers, Keys, Connected to) of one-line lamp rows, each reading name, leader, detail. 'Change a key' sits in the Keys head column.
- Then the cost band, with its tube at 18rem beside the sentence.

9) CHAT
- The thread is centred at 48rem, with speaker and time in ONE left timetable gutter.
- Vera's lines are on rounded glass; the family's are square #1f272e boxes with a 2px needle edge. Keep the round amber avatars.

10) IDEAS
- List first.
- The filters in a raised box, with Search full width on its own row.
- The radar a thin-case scope of at most 8rem, set at the top right of the list band, with `.crt .dist{white-space:nowrap}`.

11) MONITORS: a thin, square case, not oxblood.
- #363b40 with .45rem padding and 12px/16px radii.
- A 1px #59616a groove, fine vents and a #6dff9c LED.

12) TYPE
- Instrument Sans is the one sans, in two widths:
  - display (masthead, band heads) at wdth 80, weight 600, -.015em, +.04em word-spacing, line-height 1.0 rather than Magic Eye's .94;
  - reading at wdth 100.
- IBM Plex Mono for facts, times, ids and the spaced-caps links, all tabular.
- VT323 for the tubes, the weekday and month labels, and the field labels, always at 1rem or larger.
- Seven steps, kept from Magic Eye: 3.1 masthead; 2 question and month; 1.45 band heads; 1.15 panel heads; 1 body; .875 meta; .74 labels.
- Measure 68ch; decks at most 48ch, balanced.

13) CONTROLS
- A 2px #6dff9c ring at 2px offset on everything, checkboxes, radios and select:open included.
- Square wells #1b2126 with a #5b6570 edge.
- `select{padding-right:2.4rem}`.
- base-select pickers.
- Flat, square keys.
- 0/56 small targets on Home.

BUDGET: Magic Eye's css is 23.1k. Dropping the wine and needle-rose rules and the brackets frees about 2k for the bands and leaders.

briefs.name: Flight Deck
briefs.hypothesis:
NOVELTY: it opens a motif family never tried in about a hundred palettes, the 1980s GLASS COCKPIT. The family's things sit on matte instrument-panel plates grouped by fine demarcation lines; the machine sits on flush display units in thin, square, screwed faceplates. Every colour carries one meaning from the 1982 EFIS code: green active or live, cyan selected or entered by the crew (here, the family), white labels and computed data, amber caution, red warning.

It is bred from distant parents, not neighbours of the leader:
- Front Panel (r5-idea-2, silk-screened front panel: 7.31 in round 5, dropped out in round 7, 7.28 from Signal Galley), for legends set into panel lines and lamps;
- Indigo Noren (r4-rand-1, 7.09 from Signal Galley), for hardware detail on the case;
- Cloth and Glass (r4-rand-6, 8.81 from Signal Galley), for one focus ring everywhere;
- Headland Light (r7-rand-3), for targets and weekend shading.

Why it could beat the four:
(a) The feedback lens's strongest positive signal is fine line art that rings, groups and segments, echoed on every page. Today only Signal Galley's Coming up carries it. Cockpit overhead panels group controls with exactly such lines, with the group name set in a break, and as brackets rather than tracks with stops they avoid Signal Box's subway-map and git-graph reading.
(b) The feedback lens asked for 80s/90s CRT colour (cyan, CGA) in place of violet. The EFIS code gives each colour one job, which the system lens rewards.
(c) The case critique, unsolved in every entrant since round 7, is solved by the ARINC faceplate: thin, square and detailed.
(d) Status, least changed in Signal Galley and least green in Reverse Video, becomes an annunciator panel.
(e) 'Here' and 'now' are drawn as boxes, not glow.

Its open plates with brackets, label-over-data rows, screwed square display units, annunciators and boxed selection make it clearly different from every carried palette: Signal Galley's railed trays and stations, Reverse Video's full steel frames and reverse video, Magic Eye's wine guide, Plotting Room's bays. Expect a look-distance well over 1.5 from each.
briefs.brief:
BUILD from today's templates plus Signal Galley's strip() macro in variants/r8-idea-1/templates/_ui.html, the proven row with its facts slot and 44px targets. Bring none of its fortnight line, trays or Oxford rails.

TOKENS (all checked for contrast)
- Ground and fills:
  - bg #0b0e0c;
  - surface, the PANEL, #171c1f (h234, C .0095, matte night panel); surface-2 #1c2226; surface-3 #212a30;
  - field #0c1012.
- Lines: line #242a2e, line-2 #323a40, card-edge #2e353b, edge #6a747c (3.6:1 on panels).
- Text: ink #d6d2c8 (12.9:1), ink-2 #b5b1a8, dim #9f9b93, faint #928e86, heading #ece8de (bone white), label #aab4bf.
- accent: CYAN #a3c3da (h239; 9.3:1 on panels; 12.6/5.1/5.2 from plans); secondary #b7c4ce.
- Colours: lit and outing #86d9a6; the learned section colours.
- Parts:
  - bar #0f1316, the glareshield;
  - bezel #2a2f33, the display-unit faceplate;
  - bubble #111712; bubble-them #1c2328.
- Light: wash #4f60e6 at 2.3; glow .9; screenGlow .8; quietFilter.
- CSS vars: --demarc #5b666f (3.3:1 on bg), --sel (1.5px solid the accent), --now (1.5px solid #6dff9c).

THE COLOUR CODE: one table, written into the stylesheet's head comment, holding on every page.
- #6dff9c = active or live only: the mark, Send, 'mind', the focus ring, live lamps, the tubes and the NOW box.
- Sage = on or done.
- CYAN = selected, or entered by the family:
  - the selection box and links;
  - the family's names in facts ('for Maya, Theo', 'Alex', 'Sam');
  - the edge of the family's chat boxes.
- Bone white = legends, headings and titles.
- Amber = caution only. Red = warning or off only.
- No magenta anywhere.

DRAWINGS
1) PANEL (what the family reads): a matte #171c1f plate with 2px corners, a machined edge (`inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.04), 0 1px 0 #0008`) and no border.

2) DEMARCATION LINE (the line art), one per panel.
- A 1px --demarc line starts with a 1rem stub, breaks for the panel's legend (icon and name), runs right, and breaks again for the panel's links at its right end.
- At the left it turns down with a 6px radius and runs beside the rows to the last one, ending in a 6px foot tick.
- The right side stays open: a bracket, never a full box, so it never reads as Reverse Video's frame or a fieldset.
- Inside act panels, short secondary lines group related controls:
  - one line under From, Send where I am, the mic and Send, broken for nothing;
  - one bracket round the Ideas filters;
  - one per settings group, with the group's heading set in its break.
- Legends: Martian Mono 500 .76rem caps at wdth 80, +.03em, bone.
- Links in the line: Plex Sans 500 .875rem cyan, underlined.
- Put links in the head row in the DOM, before the list, so Tab order matches.

3) DISPLAY UNIT (the machine)
- Every tube sits in a square ARINC faceplate: #2a2f33, 7px at the sides and top, a 14px bottom rail, 4px outer radius, a 1px bevel (`inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.07), inset 0 0 0 1px #3a4147`) and 6px glass corners.
- Four 7px screw heads at the corners: radial-gradient discs from #474e54 to #2a2f33, each with a 1px slot drawn by a linear-gradient, all in background layers, not content.
- A photocell dot and the #6dff9c power LED in the bottom rail.
- Used for: Next up; the Ideas radar (its range rings already make it a nav display); the spend readout; Sign in; the 404.

4) ROW: the flight computer's line pair, a small label line over a large data line.
- Coming up:
  - a 2.75rem designator: day numeral 1.4rem Martian Mono, lining tabular, with the month and weekday in caps;
  - label line: the date and time, Martian Mono .72rem caps, steel;
  - data line: the title, Plex Sans 1rem/600, bone;
  - right: 'in 2 days', Martian Mono .82rem tabular, fixed 6.5rem.
- To do: tick well | label = the owner in cyan | data = the task | right = the due state, amber when late.
- Lately added: a kind-icon designator on a 14% (cool kinds) or 6% (warm kinds) tint | label = the kind and 'for …' | data = the title | right = '#N'.
- Rows are at least 2.75rem, split by a 1px dotted line-2. Hover: a surface-2 fill with a .9s afterglow.

5) SELECTION = A CYAN BOX
- The current bar place, the current tab, the current Settings entry and the hovered picker option get a 1.5px square cyan outline over a 10% cyan fill. This is the avionics sign for 'selected'.
- No reverse video, pill, latched key or dot.
- Phone: the current cell is a #1f2a31 solid with the cyan box.

6) NOW = A GREEN BOX: today on the month and Next up's '[TODAY]' tag are boxed in 1.5px #6dff9c, with no glow.

7) ANNUNCIATORS (Status)
- Each item is a lighted legend capsule: surface-2 with a 1px line-2 edge, at least 2.75rem, the name over the detail.
- A 4px bar down its left edge shows the state: sage for on, #6dff9c for live, amber for needs a look, and a dark bar with a red hollow square for off.
- Keep the three columns, each a panel with its bracket and legend. The spend display unit sits below, at 20rem beside its sentence.

8) CAUTION
- Finish setting up and Something to eat: a #131612 plate with its demarcation line in amber #8a6a34 and an amber legend. Keep the sentence-case sans for 'Finish setting up'.
- `.setup.setup` goes last.

PAGES
- Home:
  - The greeting keeps its lit glass pool and cobalt corner. The ask box is the scratchpad: a filled field with the lit sage frame and halo while typing.
  - Next up is a display unit.
  - Then Finish setting up at full width.
  - Then, at 64rem and wider, two columns placed by content: Coming up then Lately added on the left; To do, then the kids' wishes, then Something to eat on the right.
  - Side-by-side legends share one baseline; panels end with their rows; DOM, visual and Tab order agree.
- Chat:
  - The thread sits on a panel.
  - Vera's lines are glass (12px: the machine is round).
  - The family's lines are square surface-3 boxes with a 2px cyan left edge.
  - Speaker and time are the box's label line: one place for times, never both sides. At most 58ch.
- Ideas:
  - List first.
  - A filter panel: Search full width on its own row, then Kind, Status, For and Filter at 2.75rem, under one bracket.
  - The radar display unit, at most 20rem, beside it, with `.crt .dist{white-space:nowrap}`.
  - Tabs are square keys; the cyan box marks the current one.
- Plans:
  - A month panel: 1px rules, transparent cells, weekend columns shaded at a 60% panel mix.
  - Events are plans-tinted plates with a 2px plans edge.
  - Today in the green box.
- To do page: a panel per group, with the same rows.
- Settings: the nav list with the cyan box; forms as surface-2 act panels with their group headings set into the lines.
- Sign in and 404: a panel beside the display unit.

TYPE
- IBM Plex Sans for reading, titles and data.
- Martian Mono at wdth 75-87.5 for legends, labels, facts and times: condensed caps need no extra tracking, which answers the 'mono caps over-spaced' note. If it reads too technical at small size, fall back to IBM Plex Mono at .74rem, +.04em.
- VT323 only on the display units.
- Steps: masthead 2.75rem/700 at -.018em with its deck (at most 44ch) on the baseline; data 1rem/600; detail .875rem; legends .76rem; labels .72rem; facts .82rem tabular; day numerals 1.4rem.

CONTROLS
- Fields are filled and bounded: #0c1012 with a 1px #6a747c edge.
- A 2px #6dff9c ring at 2px offset everywhere, checkboxes, radios and select:open included.
- Square wells #1b2126 with a 1.5px #5b6570 edge; ticked = a sage fill with a dark tick.
- base-select pickers drawn as panels.
- Keys flat and square with a 1px line-2 edge; the mic square.
- scrollbar-color #323a40 on bg.
- 0/56 small targets on Home, 0/97 on To do.

DO NOT:
- yokes, knobs or decorative gauges;
- magenta;
- a cyan fill larger than a selection box;
- glowing lines;
- a full box round any section;
- caps legends above .8rem;
- a fourth face.

lessons:
## Round 9

Top four by score: r9-idea-2 Programme Guide 8.11; r9-idea-1 Signal Legend 7.51; r9-idea-3 Flight Deck 7.44; r8-idea-1 Signal Galley 7.1.

- Programme Guide won (in 8 top fours, 8 promise votes) because its identity comes from typesetting rather than paint, which is what the owner's "reflect more of the page content" asked for: slate bands with a head column, one-line rows read along a dotted leader to a tabular facts column on Home, Ideas, To do, Status and Settings alike, condensed Instrument Sans heads, the kind named in its own colour at the row's end, and a tuning scale under the bar with a needle under the current page. It had 9 idea rows above the fold, Home in 1646px, a one-screen month and 0 small targets. It also gave the best answer yet to the case critique: a thin, grooved case with vents, an LED and scanlines. This refines round 8's graft of Magic Eye's rows: they win once they sit on slate and lose the wine. Its fixes: heads wrap in the 10rem head column ("Finish / setting up"), so widen it to 11.5-12rem or set heads at 1.3rem with text-wrap:balance, and stack them above the rows below about 72rem (40rem on the phone). Head links in spaced mono caps read as labels; set them in sentence case, underlined, in denim (#9db6d6). Draw a leader only where a facts cell follows, give the facts fixed sub-columns, and cap the row at about 60-62rem. Swap the VT323 field labels, which are fuzzy and a fourth voice, for Plex Mono 500 at .72rem with .04em tracking. A needle for "here" does not survive the squint, so use Signal Legend's reverse block. Nothing is live below the fold, so graft the breathing now lamp into Coming up's next date.
- Signal Legend (7.51) is the consensus breed done faithfully: rail legends, steel reverse video for "here" (bar, tabs, Settings, today on the month, so amber keeps one job), square ticks and underlined rail links. It was the clearest state system on the panel. It lost on being too close to its parent, and its steel is so low in chroma that the page reads greyer than Signal Galley. Plex Sans Bold at 3rem is clunky, and its Chat times sit far from the bubbles. Refines round 8: "quiet the steel" can go too far. Keep the reverse block but give the companion enough chroma to carry a mood.
- FAILED REACHES. (1) Flight Deck (7.44, 8 promise votes) has the best-argued colour code since round 1: a 1982 EFIS glass cockpit was a CRT, so cyan means entered or selected by the family, bone means data, amber means caution and green means on. It also answered the case critique with thin, square, screwed faceplates. It fell short because actions and disclosures were set as caps legends in the demarcation lines ("ADD SOMETHING TO DO", "SAVE A THOUGHT FOR LATER"), setup links were drawn as checkboxes, .76rem Martian Mono legends made heads smaller than their rows, seven full-brand bars on Status spread the glow, and its cyan sits about 5 dE from Tokyo Night. To try again, keep the code and the faceplates, keep every action a button, and calm the Status lamps. (2) Signal Lines (6.86, the feedback judge's 8.6, but 6.1-6.7 from the skeptic, system and type judges) carried Signal Box's rings and tracks onto every page. It confirms round 7: the lines earn their place where they carry order (Chat's track, To do's timetable, the setup track), and read as a git graph where they only decorate (a ring on every head). Round tick lamps look like timeline stops, the 5px dot for "here" is too weak, and a form inside the To do bracket costs about 500px on the phone. To try again, draw lines only where there is sequence, keep ticks square, and pair them with Flight Deck's faceplate and a cyan near #8fbfdc. (3) Attract Mode's power-on roll bar was the best tube behaviour of the round, and its keys and wells had the clearest affordance, so keep both. (4) Porcelain Atlas's section discs in the bar, words for Memory, Family and Status, and the airglow under the tube are worth keeping. (5) The departures-board Next up in Plotting Room, Rehung failed because a 5:1 tube is not a period screen (they were 4:3) and it enlarged the pewter slab.
- TRAITS. The informed entrants took the top three places. The random entrants (5.04, 5.00) again lost on usability rolls: 41-45 of 56 Home targets were under 44px. Attract Mode's "keycaps" controls rolled about 36px keys and a latched tab that reads backwards (the chosen one looks off). Porcelain Atlas's "single centred reading column" ran Home to 2942px and left half the desktop empty, its "no icons beside words" roll lost recognition on the phone tab bar, and serif body text at .8rem is thin on dark. Both rolled ground hue 169 "a step lighter", and the teal-graphite read as one blue-green family with the phosphor, as in rounds 4-6. The mutants were worst of all. Magic Eye, Retitled (4.48) added Fraunces, which wrapped in the margin and faded for the fifth time, while the softer text was invisible. Plotting Room, Rehung (6.06) got one step brighter ink, against the calm brief, and a rearranged Home that grew 170px. The crossover Bakelite Video (5.66) showed that structure transfers cleanly (it kept 0 small targets and Reverse Video's grammar) but that colour does not rescue or sink it evenly: the oxblood filled every window, and squinted it read as Christmas, with red off-rings on red Status and a greige "here" block that looks disabled. Its legends at .68rem were too small. There was no separate type or graphics mutant this round. The type traits the panel rewarded were condensed Instrument Sans heads over text-width body with Plex Mono facts (seven steps), label-over-data rows, and tabular numerals. It did not reward VT323 labels, Fraunces or Newsreader, Figtree (generic SaaS), all-caps nav and buttons, or mono caps under .72rem. On graphics, it rewarded the tuning scale, faceplate screws, scanlines, and lines that carry sequence. It did not reward a ring round every icon, dots for "here", or starfields.
- Colour roles: amber keeps one job, confirmed by every informed entrant fixing today's amber disc. Suggested companions were a lower-chroma cyan of about #8fbfdc (less blue than periwinkle) and a denim link colour of #9db6d6. Oxblood, wine and rose failed again wherever they filled a surface. Only a material used sparingly can work.
- Usability was raised by the owner. The panel found these recurring faults: links and disclosures re-set as caps legends, controls redrawn as diagram marks, "here" as a needle or dot, and a message's time far from its bubble. Send on the From row, the one-screen month and one green primary per page were rewarded everywhere. Four judges ask for a dedicated usability judge scoring tasks (find the next plan, tick a to-do, send as someone, see what's broken, filter Ideas) on desktop and phone.
- Open problems: no entrant yet combines Programme Guide's listing, Signal Legend's now lamp, rail legends and reverse video, and Flight Deck's colour code and faceplate. Below the fold is still dead on the leader. The pewter slab survives in every Signal child except Signal Legend's thinner one.

Candidate principles for the Phosphor Interface standard:
16. Every list is one row read to an aligned facts column: title, leader, then tabular facts in fixed sub-columns, the same on every page.
17. A control keeps the drawing people already know: a box to tick, an underline to follow, a raised key to press, and a filled cell for "here". The period grammar dresses it and never replaces it.
18. Each colour has one job across the whole page, stated as a code (for example cyan for what the family chose, amber for caution, #6dff9c for live), and no surface is filled with a hue that has a job.
